HexKagune 1.0.21 for Forge 1.20.1 (clients need PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon). Install on client and server (protocol 42). Testing build.

- **Peace has more heft:** the blades are bigger (the great pair about 15% larger) and frame you much wider.
- **Peace's arms stretch:** they visibly thin out when reaching far and thicken when drawn in. At rest, blades now and then reach far out ahead and snap back.
- **Peace's blows reach farther:** deeper wind-ups and an overshoot on impact. Lance about 4.6 blocks, Sweep about 3 blocks around you, Scissor, Crucifix and the new heavies all farther.
- **Peace's wings breathe and flutter more,** and stream back harder when running.
